name: robots/robo-eval__roboeval
title: RoboEval LiftPotPosition (MuJoCo bimanual manipulation)
intro: RoboEval LiftPotPosition (MuJoCo bimanual manipulation), adapted from robo-eval/roboeval. It reads `observation` and `tick`; runs `reset_world` and `step`. `reset_world`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
